title: Probability of matching a fixed assignment
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $P$ be a subset of $\\{0,\\ldots,n-1\\}$, and assign a sign $z_i\\in\\{-1,1\\}$ to each $i\\in P$. For a uniformly random sign vector $x\\in\\{-1,1\\}^n$, the probability that $x_i=z_i$ for every $i\\in P$ is $2^{-|P|}$.
